name: PhoneField
summary: A phone number with a country code picker, Gulf countries first. The value out is E.164.
useWhen: A mobile or landline number that may be outside the home country
A number you will send a text message or call to, and need in E.164 form
A sign up or checkout form for the Gulf, where most numbers are SA, AE, KW, QA, BH or OM
avoidWhen: A one time code sent to the phone
A number that is always local and stored as typed

value.description: The number in E.164 form, +966501234567, controlled. An empty string clears it.

defaultValue.description: The first number in E.164 form, uncontrolled.

onValueChange.type: (value: string, detail: { country: string; national: string; valid: boolean }) => void
onValueChange.description: Called with the E.164 number (empty while there are no digits). valid is the length check for the country.

country.description: The selected country, an ISO 3166 code, controlled.

onCountryChange.description: Called when the country changes, from the picker or from a pasted +number.

countries.description: Limits the picker to these ISO codes. The Gulf countries in the list still come first.

locale.description: Language of the country names. Default: the lang of the nearest Theme.

labels.type: { country?: string; gulf?: string; all?: string }
labels.description: The picker's accessible name and its two group labels. English and Arabic defaults follow the language.

name.description: A hidden input with this name posts the E.164 number with the form.

size.description: Height from size.control: 24, 28, 32 and 44 px at default density.

shape.description: default takes radius.control from the style. pill is always fully round.

invalid.description: Marks the number invalid. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

disabled.description: Disables the picker and the number. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

readOnly.description: The number stays focusable and readable; the picker is not shown, only the dial code.

required.description: Sets aria-required on the number. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

rootProps.description: Props for the root box. className and style also go to the root; every other native prop and the ref go to the number input.

a11y.role: combobox for the native select (country), textbox for the native tel input (number)
a11y.focus: Two tab stops: the country picker, then the number. Focus on either shows the glow and the 2px ring around the box; the dial code also fills while the picker has focus.

keys.Tab: Moves focus to the country picker, then to the number
keys.ArrowUp, ArrowDown: On the picker, choose the previous or the next country (native select)
keys.Enter, Space: On the picker, open the country list (native select, by platform)
keys.Home, End: On the number, move the caret to the start or the end

a11y.announce: The number takes its name from the Field label, the description and error through aria-describedby. The picker is named Country code plus the Field label (Country code, Mobile number) and reads the country name and its dial code. Read only, the number is described by its dial code.
notes: The country is a native select (decision 4 of wave 1): the platform picker on phones and type ahead on desktops. It covers the dial code and is transparent, so the closed state shows +966 and not a long country name.
The number always runs left to right (dir ltr on the input), also inside Arabic. The dial code is isolated in a bdi. In Arabic the dial code sits at the start (right) and the number next to it.
A pasted or autofilled +9665... or 009665... sets the country. Arabic Indic digits are read. The trunk 0 of SA and AE is dropped: 050 becomes 50.
Gulf numbers are grouped as typed (50 123 4567, 5000 1234) and checked for length. Other countries keep their digits as typed and get the E.164 limit only.

The value out is E.164 from onValueChange and the hidden input named name. Keep the last detail from onValueChange and check detail.valid on blur or on submit, never on every key. Changing the country keeps the digits; detail.valid says whether their length fits the new country.
Paste and autofill are never blocked (WCAG 2.2, 3.3.8).

en.label: A noun in sentence case: Mobile number, Office number. Never Phone # or Tel.
en.placeholder: The Gulf example comes by default: 50 123 4567. Never the label.
en.error: Say how many digits and give an example: Enter the 9 digits after +966, for example 50 123 4567.

ar.label: رقم الجوال، رقم المكتب
ar.error: وضح كم رقم ومثال: اكتب 9 أرقام بعد +966، مثل 50 123 4567

react.behavior: hand built on a native select and a native tel input

styles.studio: The Input pill with the dial code at the start behind a divider, the soft glow and the 2px achromatic ring on focus
styles.desk: The same box and ring, digits in Instrument Sans with tabular figures

mistakes.wrong: A custom dropdown for the country
mistakes.right: PhoneField's native select: the platform picker on phones and type ahead

mistakes.wrong: Blocking paste or stripping the plus
mistakes.right: Leave paste on; a pasted +number sets the country

mistakes.wrong: dir rtl on the number in an Arabic form
mistakes.right: PhoneField keeps the number left to right

mistakes.wrong: Checking the length on every key
mistakes.right: Keep the last detail from onValueChange and check detail.valid on blur or on submit
